يستعجلوا (form X)

# يُسْتَعْجَلُوا (yustaʕjalū) /jus.taʕ.d͡ʒa.luː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعْجَلَ (istaʕjala)
